question: Is the CD limit of detection lower than UV-vis for every strain where both are reported, and by how much?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%LOD%' OR text ILIKE '%limit of detection%' OR text ILIKE '%detection limit%' OR text ILIKE '%S17%' ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, figure_id, fact_no, statement, value, unit FROM figure_facts WHERE statement ILIKE '%LOD%' OR statement ILIKE '%detection%' OR statement ILIKE '%limit%'
SELECT id, text, value, unit, role, property, about, method, quantity FROM measures WHERE sentence ILIKE '%LOD%' OR sentence ILIKE '%limit of detection%'
SELECT id, page, line_no, text FROM lines WHERE page=6 AND line_no BETWEEN 55 AND 63 ORDER BY line_no
SELECT id, text, value, unit, role, about, method, quantity FROM measures WHERE id IN ('p6.L59:19#35','p6.L59:19#65','p6.L59:19#136','p6.L59:19#166')

WITH v AS (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p6.L59'),'=(0\.[0-9]+)',1) AS DOUBLE) AS cd_pa, CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p6.L60'),'versus (0\.[0-9]+)',1) AS DOUBLE) AS uv_pa, CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p6.L61'),'LOD of (0\.[0-9]+)',1) AS DOUBLE) AS cd_lm, CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p6.L61'),'versus (0\.[0-9]+)',1) AS DOUBLE) AS uv_lm) SELECT round(uv_pa - cd_pa, 4) AS diff_pa, round(uv_lm - cd_lm, 4) AS diff_lm, cd_pa, uv_pa, cd_lm, uv_lm FROM v

rendered: Yes. The document gives an LOD by CD and by UV–vis only for the strains named below, and for each of them the CD LOD is lower. The authors state that CD consistently achieved a lower limit of detection than UV–vis.[1] For P. aeruginosa, the CD LOD is OD600 0.0034[2] versus 0.0066[3] for UV–vis, a lower CD LOD by 0.0032[4]. For L. monocytogenes, the CD LOD is 0.0123[5] versus 0.0125[6] for UV–vis, a lower CD LOD by only 0.0002[7]. No other strain has an LOD reported in the document, so the comparison covers only these strains.
